It must be a game-ready environmental background with a calm uncluttered middle area for interactive gameplay objects. No text, lettering, logos, UI, borders, humans, tools or creatures. Low floor ledge and scattered pebbles along bottom. Atmospheric but legible, turquoise and amber accents, dim central values.
